title: Decoded prefix extraction
statement: Given a Boolean list $p$, decode it into two Boolean lists $u$ and $v$ using the pair decoder. The defined list is the prefix of $v$ of length equal to the length of $u$.
caveat: The supplied statement does not define the pair decoder, so its convention cannot be specified.
